import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from app.habits import add_habit, list_habits, tick, ticks


class HabitsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.db = Path(self.folder.name) / "habits.sqlite3"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.folder.cleanup()

    def test_add_habit_is_listed(self):
        add_habit(self.db, "Read")
        self.assertEqual(list_habits(self.db), ["Read"])

    def test_tick_is_kept_once_per_day(self):
        add_habit(self.db, "Read")
        tick(self.db, "Read", "2026-10-01")
        tick(self.db, "Read", "2026-10-01")
        self.assertEqual(ticks(self.db, "Read"), ["2026-10-01"])

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "migrations" / "002-habits.sql"


def _open(path):
    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    connection.executescript(SCHEMA.read_text())
    return connection


def add_habit(path, name):
    with _open(path) as connection:
        connection.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO habits (name) VALUES (?)", (name,))


def list_habits(path):
    with _open(path) as connection:
        return [row[0] for row in connection.execute("SELECT name FROM habits ORDER BY id")]


def tick(path, name, day):
    with _open(path) as connection:
        connection.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ticks (habit, day) VALUES (?, ?)", (name, day))


def ticks(path, name):
    with _open(path) as connection:
        return [row[0] for row in connection.execute("SELECT day FROM ticks WHERE habit = ? ORDER BY day", (name,))]
